US Republicans Vow No Policy Change After Midterm Losses

Following midterm election results where Republicans experienced losses, US Representative Mark Mullin stated there would be "zero change" on immigration policy. Separately, Senator Marco Rubio asserted that former President Trump's foreign policy approach would remain unaltered despite the Republican party's performance in the elections.
